guide.title: MediDaegu Guidebook
guide.subtitle: Find a clinic in Daegu, request a consultation or booking, and get aftercare — how to use MediDaegu, step by step.
guide.footnote: MediDaegu helps you find clinics and connects your consultation and booking requests. Diagnosis and treatment are done by the clinic, and you pay the clinic directly.

about.title: What MediDaegu does
items: See Daegu clinic information in 6 languages (Korean, English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese, Japanese).
When you request a consultation or booking, the clinic reviews and confirms it itself.
After your visit, you can send aftercare messages to that clinic’s medical staff.
Change the screen language and price currency (KRW, etc.) at the top right.
about.eyebrow: Find, ask and book in one place

start.title: Getting started: sign up
items: Clinic information and the price guide are open to everyone, no login needed.
The chatbot, Consultation / Booking, Aftercare and My page need a login.
When you sign up, answer 3 questions about your stay (alien registration, domestic residence report, National Health Insurance).
By law, only foreigners visiting Korea for a short stay for treatment can request consultations or bookings. Foreigners living in Korea can view clinic information only.

find.title: Finding a clinic
items: On the main map, tap a colored dot (one color per department) to open the clinic’s details.
In Hospitals, filter by department, district and staff language.
Languages are shown as “direct communication” or “interpreter support”.
Prices in the price guide are for reference only. Always confirm the actual cost with the clinic during your consultation.
find.eyebrow: Choose by department, area and language

chatbot.title: AI chatbot Mr. Gwon
items: Tell it the treatment and area you want — it finds clinics and helps you fill in a booking request.
It does not make medical judgments, such as reading symptoms or saying whether a procedure is safe for you. Ask the doctor at your consultation.
AI answers can be wrong. Check the date, time and details before you send a request.
chatbot.eyebrow: Just ask — it finds clinics for you

booking.title: Consultation and booking requests
items: On a clinic’s page, tap [Book] to pick a date and time, or [Contact this hospital] to start a 1:1 chat.
After you send a request it shows “Waiting for confirmation”; the clinic confirms it or suggests another time.
You can change or cancel a request yourself until the clinic confirms it.
Requests must be at least 60 minutes apart from your other bookings, 1 per clinic per day, and up to 5 waiting requests at a time.

before.title: Before your visit
items: When a clinic replies or changes a status, you’ll see it on the bell icon and the menu badge.
For confirmed bookings, reminders are sent 48 hours, 24 hours and 2 hours before your visit.
If you can’t make it, please cancel in advance so another patient can use that time.
Clinic addresses also show the original Korean. Show it to your taxi driver as is.
before.eyebrow: Reminders so you don’t miss it

after.title: After your visit
items: Once the clinic marks your visit as completed, you can chat with its medical staff in Aftercare.
The clinic is added to Visit log in My page automatically, and you can write down how it went. Only you can see it.
Your saved clinics and bookings are also gathered in My page.

safety.title: Emergencies and safety
items: In an emergency — chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding — call 119 right away.
If symptoms get worse after a procedure, call the clinic directly instead of waiting for an aftercare reply.
MediDaegu does not give medical advice and does not recommend specific clinics.

guide.closeTitle: Start your care in Daegu today
